title: F5 - content/evidence/records/<record_id>.json
description: The single curated evidence family. FOUNDATION.md 2.5 gives this table in full because it is the schema the whole honesty spine reads.

efh.keyOrderContract: Emit keys in propertyOrder exactly. FOUNDATION.md 2.3 line 156: 'object keys in the order given in the schema table (the order is part of the byte-stability contract)'.

record_id.description: R. EV-<class>-<nnnn>; minted once, never reused; registered in F5r. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 191.

record_version.description: R. Bumped on any content change. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 192.

class.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 193. Read by the 3.7 pseudocode at lines 677, 699, 705, 707.

subjects.description: R. >=1 function id; all must exist in data/functions/. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 194. Read by 3.7 line 670-671 ('whose subjects contain this id') and line 714 ('any comparison record naming s').

subject_role.description: O. Per subject. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 195. CORRECTION R22-R24 (ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS.md 2.1 lines 152-160): MATCH, XMATCH and DELTA must carry subject_role 'contrast' - BUG-FUNC-004 says four times that these three are the deliberately excluded exact-match control group. The corrections note that 2.5's schema 'already defines an unused contrast subject_role for exactly this'.

upstream_row_id.description: R. G3-02, XMD-001, BUG-FUNC-022, KED-FIN-001, FPD-003. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 197. Rendered as <stream_id> in A-52 (line 901).

upstream_register.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 198. 'residual-register' carries the four KED rows that A1-S3 requires be fed into the open-row set.

upstream_status_verbatim.description: R. The upstream status string exactly. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 199. Read by 3.7 line 708: streams are the defect-stream records whose status normalises to {open, repair-landed-unsigned}.

upstream_anchor.description: R. A3-S10. efh ingest --diff re-checks it every sync. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 200.

maturity.description: R. M0-M3 | HO | null. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 202.

maturity_is_inherited.description: R. true for body-only/inherited subjects. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 203.

status_plain.description: R. The honest paragraph; no completeness word without its scope. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 204.

oracle.description: R, may be null. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 206 and the oracle table at lines 246-259.

evidence_locality.description: R. local-only for anything behind smart-fuzzer/{runs,work,cache} or .tmp/. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 207.

evidence_locality_note.description: C. Required iff evidence_locality != 'in-repo'; template in 4.4 A-24. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 208.

reader_warning.description: R. The 'do not read this as...' sentence. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 215.

handbook_reverified.description: R. const false today for every record. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 219. This is what stops the Handbook wearing OxFunc's evidence as its own.

count.$comment: FOUNDATION 2.5 lines 221-244: 'every field is required; there are no optional fields in a count'. The table lists 20 rows. FOUNDATION 6 T4 acceptance test (b) at line 1184 says 'all 21 required fields'. The table is the schema authority, so 20 are encoded here and the 20-vs-21 discrepancy is recorded in tools/schemas/README.md rather than resolved by inventing a 21st field.

figure.description: R. Verbatim upstream string. DISPLAY ONLY. Guard G-9 (FOUNDATION 6.1 line 1206) fails the build if any tool parses it. 3.7 line 682: 'c.figure is NEVER read.'

passed.description: R. null only when the source publishes no numerator. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 226. Read by 3.7 lines 690, 695, 696, 700.

total.description: R. null only when the source publishes no denominator. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 227. Read by 3.7 lines 690, 695, 696.

axis.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 228. Read by 3.7 line 691, and by the axis-state rungs at lines 733-749.

comparison_predicate.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 229; travels with every count per A1-F3. CORRECTION R22-R24 (ATTRIBUTION-CORRECTIONS.md 2.1 lines 152-164) INVERTS FOUNDATION 3.4 line 605-607 for three of the six surfaces it names: MATCH, XMATCH and DELTA use raw IEEE == (delta_fn.rs:26 'if lhs == rhs', xmatch.rs:240 'a == b', match_fn.rs shares xmatch's comparator, none imports excel_numeric_compare) and therefore carry 'exact-typed-bit-match', not '15-significant-digit-truncation'. Only SWITCH, COUNTIF and SUMIF carry the tolerant value, and the corrections require that value be worded 'quantise-then-compare', never 'tolerant': the helper truncates each operand independently to 15 significant digits and then compares exactly, so values arbitrarily close but astride a bucket boundary compare unequal.

count_scope.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 230. Read by 3.7 line 693 (prefer_per_surface) and asserted at line 757.

group_members.description: R. Empty iff count_scope == per-surface. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 231. Supplies {k} for the 'covering {k} functions jointly' clause that 3.7 line 757 asserts and guard G-3a enforces.

attribution.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 232. Read by 3.7 lines 679 (the attribution gate) and 684 (named_only). STEWARD DECISION SD-4: legacy aliases are DEMOTED to alias-sibling-inherited and are never credited with a sibling's count.

measurement_subject.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 233. Read by 3.7 line 679 (the subject gate, A1-F7) and lines 700-702 (open_class).

held_out_rows.description: R. Required non-null when held_out in {true, partial} unless the source does not split, in which case null renders as 'the source does not split the count'. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 235.

corpus_was_repair_target.description: R. FOUNDATION 2.5 line 236; A1-S9. STEWARD DECISION SD-5: PMT's in-sample 2,304/2,304 is published carrying corpus_was_repair_target: true and its N1 open-divergence state in the same visual unit.
